title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: From the historic McCain Library to modern science lounges, these ten spots offer the best environments for focused academic work at Agnes Scott College.

cards.title: Main Reading Room
cards.subtitle: McCain Library, Floor 1
cards.notes: Study by the fireplace in this historic space featuring large windows and comfortable couches. It is a central hub for focused reading.
cards.short_summary: A grand, historic reading room on the first floor of McCain Library featuring a fireplace and large windows.
cards.evidence_claim: The Main Reading Room on Floor 1 of McCain Library features couches by the fireplace and study tables.
cards.access_notes: Open during regular library hours; current students can swipe in after 10:30 PM until 1 AM.

cards.title: Elmore Reading Room
cards.subtitle: McCain Library, Ground Floor
cards.notes: Enjoy scenic views of the Science Quad from curved couches. This ground-floor space offers a bright, modern atmosphere for group or solo work.
cards.short_summary: A scenic study area on the ground floor of McCain Library overlooking the Science Quad.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kate Durr Elmore Reading Room on the Ground Floor features scenic seating facing the Science Quad and a half-moon couch.
cards.access_notes: Accessible via the ground floor entrance; open during library hours.

cards.title: Cameron Reading Terrace
cards.subtitle: McCain Library, Floor 1
cards.notes: Take your books outside to the rocking chairs on this terrace. It is a designated area where cell phone calls and fresh air are permitted.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor terrace at McCain Library equipped with rocking chairs and WiFi.
cards.evidence_claim: The Elizabeth Henderson Cameron Reading Terrace features rocking chairs and WiFi, and is a place where cell phone calls are allowed.
cards.source_title: Favorite Study Spots in McCain Library
cards.access_notes: Outdoor access during library hours; located on the first floor.

cards.title: Floor 3 Silent Study
cards.subtitle: McCain Library, Floor 3
cards.notes: Head to the third floor for absolute silence. This zone prohibits talking and electronic devices to ensure a distraction-free environment.
cards.short_summary: A strictly silent study floor in McCain Library for distraction-free work.
cards.evidence_claim: Floor 3 and Stack 3 are designated quiet floors where no talking or electronic devices are permitted.
cards.access_notes: Open during library hours; strictly enforced silence policy.

cards.title: Bullock Graduate Lounge
cards.subtitle: Bullock Science Center
cards.notes: Utilize this dedicated lounge for graduate and post-bacc students. It provides a quiet, centrally located space for advanced research and meetings.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated study and meeting lounge for graduate students in the Bullock Science Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Graduate and post-bacc students have access to a dedicated lounge space centrally located in the Bullock Science Center.
cards.source_title: Advising & Student Resources | Agnes Scott College
cards.access_notes: Restricted to graduate and post-baccalaureate students.

cards.title: Luchsinger Lounge
cards.subtitle: Alston Campus Center
cards.notes: Study by the grand fireplace in the 'Fireplace Lounge.' This cozy spot offers comfortable furniture and views of the campus quad.
cards.short_summary: A comfortable lounge in the Alston Campus Center known for its grand fireplace.
cards.evidence_claim: The Amelia Davis Luchsinger Lounge, dubbed the 'Fireplace Lounge,' features comfortable furniture and is located in the Alston Campus Center.
cards.source_title: Small Group Venues | Agnes Scott College
cards.access_notes: Open during Alston Campus Center building hours.

cards.title: Jones Center
cards.subtitle: Campbell Hall
cards.notes: Access peer tutoring and collaborative study areas in this renovated living-learning center. It is designed for intuitive, communal academic work.
cards.short_summary: A learning center in Campbell Hall providing academic support and study spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Campbell Hall houses several learning centers, including the Jones Center for Academic Excellence, which features intuitive workspaces.
cards.access_notes: Located in Campbell Hall; accessible to students during building hours.

cards.title: Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: McCain Library, Various Floors
cards.notes: Reserve a private room for 2-8 people via LibCal. These rooms are ideal for collaborative projects and require a key checkout from the desk.
cards.short_summary: Reservable rooms in McCain Library designed for group collaboration.
cards.evidence_claim: McCain Library has five group study rooms that can be reserved for up to two hours per day via the LibCal system.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces and Carrels | Agnes Scott College
cards.access_notes: Reservation required; key must be checked out at the first-floor desk.

cards.title: Commuter Lounge
cards.subtitle: Alston Campus Center
cards.notes: Find a home base between classes in this dedicated space for off-campus students. It features lockers and comfortable seating for long study sessions.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated lounge and locker area for commuter students in the Alston Campus Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Alston Campus Center provides lounges specifically for commuter students, along with lockers for the academic year.
cards.source_title: Commuter Student Information | Agnes Scott College
cards.access_notes: Primarily for commuter students; open during building hours.

cards.title: Observatory Library
cards.subtitle: Bradley Observatory
cards.notes: Study in a unique seminar room surrounded by astronomical history. This quiet space is located within the campus's research observatory.
cards.short_summary: A library and seminar room located within the Bradley Observatory building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bradley Observatory building contains a library/seminar room and a student computer lab.
cards.access_notes: Open during observatory building hours; check for seminar schedules.
